title: Byode
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Heroes of the Realm characters)

paragraphs.text: Byode is a planeswalker of an unspecified species, who can travel between separate Universes rather than planes. Due to this they are called a Universewalker . They are black / blue aligned.

The character of Byode was created by Wizards of the Coast for a celebration card as part of the 2022 Heroes of the Realm program. The Byode, Inverse Sun card was handed out to the Universes Beyond team of Wizards of the Coast , as a token of appreciation. The name is an anagram of Universes Beyond, and the cost of the card is UB ( blue - black ), which is also the abbreviation for Universes Beyond.
